name: Havoc in the Highlands
label: Quest
description: Havoc in the Highlands: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... Just in case you don't return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.
You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
